simple.meaning: פִּתְאוֹם (pithʼôwm) is a Hebrew object word meaning “instantly.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Numbers 6:9. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פִּתְאוֹם (H6597) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H6597. pithom מִּתְאֹם , once Psa 64:8 (see Baer) מִּתְאוֺם substantive suddenness , usually as adverb accusative suddenly (from מֶּתַע , with the term. ם - (compare שִׁלְשֹׁם ), and with ע weakened to א : Sta § 295 Kö ii. 255 f. Ba NB § 216 b ); — Num 12:4 י ׳ויאמר ׳פ אלטֿשׁה , Josh 10:9 ; 11:7 ; especially of calamity, invasion, etc., coming suddenly , Isa 47:11 ; 48:3 ; Jer 4:20 ׳בּ אֹהָלי שֻׁדְּדוּ , 6:26 ; 15:8 ; 18:22 ; 51:8 ; Psalms ׳פ יִירָ֑אוּ וְלאֹ יֹרֻהוּ , 51:8 ; Job 5:3 ; 9:23 ; Eccl 9:12 ; Prov 6:15 ; 24:22 ; also 7:22 ; Mal 3:1 ; thrice with מֶּתַע (q. v.). As a Genitive Prov 3:25 פ מִמַּהַר ׳אלתֿירא of the terror of suddenness , i.e. the sudden terror, Job 22:10 ; and with בְּ , in suddenness , 2Chr 29:36 ׳בפ הדבר היה .

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!”
Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.
So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced, because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.
I have seen the foolish taking root,
If the scourge kills suddenly,
Therefore snares are around you.
They encourage themselves in evil plans.
Their own tongues shall ruin them.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear,
Therefore his calamity will come suddenly.
He followed her immediately,
for their calamity will rise suddenly.

For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
Therefore disaster will come on you.
I have declared the former things from of old.
Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas.
Let a cry be heard from their houses
Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed!

“Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple; and the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, behold, he comes!” says Yahweh of Armies.
